control_metadata.protected_invariant: Agent result evidence belongs only under /home/ubuntu/obsidian-日记/公共开发集, split by media, daily, social, knowledge, and public folders.
control_metadata.targeted_positive_case: main resolves to public, feishu-media resolves to media, all required folders exist, and Syncthing routes the diary folder id to /home/ubuntu/obsidian-日记.
control_metadata.targeted_negative_case: Retired agent-results or agents-results paths, fake /Users iCloud paths, media-vault 公共开发集 paths, hardcoded folder tuples, or OPENCLAW_AGENT_RESULTS_BASE fail static/schema/runtime checks.
control_metadata.scoped_surface_discovery: scripts/qa agent_results_path, selfmedia-tools runtime.evidence.agent_results, active/source tag-router deletion and cleanup scripts, static vault guard, schema guard, and Syncthing runtime QA.
control_metadata.exception_policy: Syncthing folder ids may remain English identifiers; physical vault paths must use the renamed Chinese directories. Runtime base override is disabled and must raise instead of silently changing roots.
control_metadata.downstream_consumer_test: source/active test_deletion.py, source/active cleanup_creation_runs.py --help, check_openclaw_single_source_contract.py, and check_feishu_tag_router_contract.py.
control_metadata.runtime_fixture_or_route: scripts/qa/check_agent_results_sync_route.py reads Syncthing config.xml and localhost REST API.
control_metadata.non_flaky_execution_boundary: Static JSON/schema/path checks plus read-only local Syncthing API readback; no Feishu writes, LLM calls, or external network calls.
control_metadata.actionable_failure_message: Fix the JSON contract or the named writer file; do not reintroduce retired path literals, fake iCloud roots, base env overrides, or duplicated folder lists.
